newsitem.title: FINLAND: MINK PRICE UP AT AUCTION - TURKISTUOTTAJAT.
newsitem.headline: MINK PRICE UP AT AUCTION - TURKISTUOTTAJAT.

text.p: Finnish fur auctioneer Turkistuottajat Oy said on Wednesday in a statement that male mink pelt prices at an auction earlier in the day were five to 10 percent higher than at an acution in Copenhagen a week ago.

"Sales rose above 90 percent of supply and especially male mink pelts rose five to 10 percent from the levels in Copenhagen," it said. "Stable mink pelt prices and good demand dispelled uncertainty from the mink market," it added.
It said the most important buyers came from Italy, Greece, Russia and Hong Kong and that "it was positive that the Russian market has clearly started to recover".
